scope: Short fresh-process allocation diagnosis, not a reproduction or pass of the original endurance gate
limitations: Five-second epochs with per-epoch GC, tracemalloc instrumentation and no fault probes differ from the original twenty-minute test.
Equal wall budgets yield different completed pass counts; individual inputs and workload order are identical.
Direct execution has lower concurrency than the matched stdlib/intelligent executor comparisons.
Allocator trim is a diagnostic operation only, not used by the package or to decide the original gate.
Reclaimable pages do not establish which allocator/library caused the high-water or prove leak freedom.

public_metadata_projection.scope: metadata-only public projection; all numeric measurements, configuration choices, source hashes and hardware characteristics unchanged
public_metadata_projection.redacted: absolute interpreter/checkout/temporary paths and report-only hardware fingerprint values
public_metadata_projection.saved_configuration_status: report copies containing redacted fingerprints are intentionally not loadable saved profiles; runtime APIs and raw evidence are unchanged
public_metadata_projection.original_selection_hash_status: original frozen selection hashes are retained as run provenance; metadata-redacted selection content has a separate projected hash
